clips.title: The story
paras: Retrieval for Mauren is a quest given by Collin Mauren in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind. Hearing tales of travelers venturing deep into Kalimdor, the wizard contracts Alliance adventurers to gather crystallised scales from basilisks dwelling in Stonetalon's Charred Vale. Mauren seeks these rare specimens to grind into dust as reagents for his personal spellcraft.

Collin Mauren, a wizard residing in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City, keeps an ear close to the chatter of wandering adventurers. Word has reached him that the distant Stonetalon Mountains in Kalimdor have become a burgeoning hotspot for travelers seeking wild wyverns, unruly elementals, or lucrative deals and clashes with the Venture Company. Rather than seeking riches or glory, Mauren's interest lies in the rare natural wonders reported from the region's harshest corners.

Deep within Stonetalon lies the Charred Vale, an ash-choked expanse left scarred by the Venture Company's devastation. According to Mauren's studies, the basin was once known to house a peculiar breed of basilisk. When harvested and crushed into a fine powder, their scales form a potent catalyst for specialized arcane spells he has developed. Unsure whether the creatures managed to survive the harsh transformation of the Vale, Mauren relies on intrepid explorers to harvest a fresh batch of crystallised scales and confirm whether the breed endures.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.
Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.
If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.
Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you already returned from the Vale in Stonetalon with those scales?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is perfect, friend. Thank you greatly.
Perhaps one day in the future I'll be able to help you as you have helped me.
